comparison_notes: Four arms have 8451 parameters, identical initialization and paired minibatches. All start at identity; no historical endpoint initializes a run.

All arms use anchored features. Adam consumes true gradients and keeps ordinary moments; chart arms precondition only the orientation projection proposal, preserving its current Adam proposal L2 norm up to f32 rounding. This does not match cumulative norms across diverging runs.
Rust owns the mean two-coordinate feature pullback, relative damping and normalized solve. The ordinary tangent control uses the same operator on its constant anchor Jacobian.

This separable chart metric omits hidden-input covariance, readout and loss curvature. It is neither full natural gradient nor a loss Hessian. No optimizer is silently inserted into production autograd.
Relative damping is fixed at 0.1 before training. No development-based model or hyperparameter selection. Complete all twelve runs and exact next-update checks before endpoint evaluation.

Primary contrast: chart_elliptic minus adam_elliptic. Also report chart effects on tangent, geometry with each optimizer, the interaction and every losing seed. Ordinary adam_tangent remains the practical reference.
Pride and Alice are reused exploratory endpoints, not untouched confirmation. Historical Adam control reproduction is reproducibility evidence, not independent replication.
CPU float32, frozen local GPT-2, full unpadded contexts, no KV cache. Extra geometry computation and host copies are not a speed comparison or a matched-compute claim.
